content: नाथ् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (नाथति, but sometimes <ab>Ā.</ab> also) .²1 To ask, beg, solicit for anything (with <ab>dat.</ab> or two <ab>acc.</ab>); मोक्षाय नाथते मुनिः <ls>Vop.</ls>; नाथसे किमु पतिं न भूभृतः <ls>Ki. 13. 59</ls>; संतुष्टमिष्टानि तमिष्टदेवं नाथन्ति के नाम न लोकनाथम् <ls>N. 3. 25</ls>; वनं न यायादिति नाथमानः <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 54</ls>. .²2 To have power, be master, prevail. .²3 To harass, trouble. .²4 To bless, wish well to, give blessings to; (said to be <ab>Ātm.</ab> only in this sense); धृत्या नाथस्व वैदेहि … <ls>Bk. 8. 120</ls>; नाथितशमे <ls>Mv. 1. 11</ls>; (Mammaṭa quotes the line दीनं त्वामनुनाथते कुचयुगं पत्रावृतं मा कृथाः to show that नाथ् here only means ‘to ask or beg’, and says that नाथते should, therefore, be नाथति); सर्पिषो नाथते <ls>Sk.</ls>
